name: Heathens can be selected in Island Events/Heathen-Exclusive Events
description: New Believers. Ordinary Heathens can be chosen for the roles of the new island events that allow them, and events written for the Heathens alone (Heathen-Exclusive Events) can happen. A chief, the Retired Chief and the puzzles' Heathens are never chosen. Heathens get the same personal outcomes as your villagers. When only Heathens are in an event, the outcomes for the whole tribe (food, tech points, buildings, goods, research) happen to the Heathens' village instead and change nothing in yours: their lines end "(no effect)". When Heathens and villagers are in an event together, those outcomes reach your tribe as usual. Heathens never count in the Village Statistics, and the Island Events log marks them "Faction: Heathen". For now a Heathen is never chosen where an outcome could kill them, make them disappear, make them pregnant or copy them. Which roles allow Heathens is set per event; the game's own island events are unchanged. Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Needs Story / Cheat Upgrades.** **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.**
output_tag: Heathens can be selected in Island Events/Heathen-Exclusive Events

needs_on.for: the island-event engine that chooses the villagers

behavior_changes: Story / Cheat Upgrades casts an ordinary Heathen (faction set, never roles 12-17, never sick) in a new event's role marked "heathens": "allowed" or "only" while this row is installed; a role marked "only" takes no believer, and without this row nobody, so its event is not offered.

When every villager cast is a Heathen, the event's food, tech points, award, building damage or repair, goods, trades, tech level and whole-village effects are made nowhere: each automatic line says it happens to the Heathens' village (the Isolans' village with Guardians of Isola Rewrite) and ends "(no effect)".
More Island Events casts a Heathen only in a role its table names (none yet).
The Island Events log ends each Heathen's record with "Faction: Heathen" ("Isolan" with Guardians of Isola Rewrite).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte, game file or save is changed: the row is only a name in the installed patches' list ("VVFP Installed Patches.txt") that Story / Cheat Upgrades and More Island Events read.
The game's own island events, their text, their villagers and their chances are never changed.
A Heathen never counts in the Village Statistics; the puzzles' Heathens are never chosen.
evidence_status: the casting, the flavor-only effects and the log line pinned in tests/test_heathens_in_island_events.py (emulated); runtime/player confirmation pending
